title: Metro Colombo Urban Development Project environmental assessment — Meethotamulla response
author_or_institution: World Bank / Government of Sri Lanka
author_institution: World Bank / Government of Sri Lanka
scope: Meethotamulla dumpsite collapse and solid-waste governance response
limitations: Project environmental assessment; event figures are contemporaneous administrative totals and should remain dated.

title: X-Press Pearl Maritime Disaster Sri Lanka — UN Environmental Advisory Mission
scope: Environmental, coastal, fisheries and plastic-spill impacts of X-Press Pearl
limitations: Mission report during an unfolding incident; later compensation/litigation totals require later anchors.

title: The M/V X-Press Pearl Nurdle Spill: Contamination of Burnt Plastic and Unburnt Nurdles along Sri Lanka's Beaches
author_or_institution: ACS Environmental Au / de Vos et al.
scope: Estimated mass and physical character of the X-Press Pearl nurdle spill
limitations: Scientific estimate of spilled preproduction plastic; not a total mass estimate for every pollutant/cargo class.

title: Ministry of Fisheries progress report — X-Press Pearl compensation
scope: Fishing ban, interim compensation and identified affected workers after X-Press Pearl
limitations: Administrative compensation population is not identical to all environmentally affected households.

title: Cabinet decision on single-use plastic and polythene waste management
scope: Policy intent for bans effective 2021 and prior 2017 plastic restrictions
limitations: Records adopted policy intent, not enforcement or environmental effect.

title: Cabinet decision on control of single-use plastic/polythene waste
scope: Additional single-use plastic prohibitions proposed for 2023
limitations: Policy intent only; does not establish compliance or enforcement effect.

title: Illegal waste containers successfully repatriated from Sri Lanka
scope: Return to England of 21 illegally exported waste containers shipped to Sri Lanka in 2017
limitations: Covers one enforcement case, not the total scale of waste imports to Sri Lanka.

title: Sri Lanka — Tsunami Emergency Recovery Program, Report No. 32221-LK
scope: Early official/JNA-based tsunami mortality, displacement, housing and district impacts
limitations: Early post-disaster estimates; casualty/displacement totals changed as records stabilized.

title: Sri Lanka: Tsunami-Affected Areas Rebuilding Project
scope: Later evaluation of tsunami damage distribution and rebuilding needs
limitations: Project evaluation; useful for retrospective validation, not contemporaneous political causality by itself.

title: Sri Lanka post-tsunami recovery analysis — buffer zone policy
scope: 100/200m setback policy, relocation and policy reversals during 2005
limitations: Synthesis drawing on government notices and recovery studies; claims about tourism capture require separate direct evidence.

title: Freedom in the World 2006 — Sri Lanka
scope: P-TOMS agreement, JVP coalition withdrawal, Supreme Court intervention and political consequences
limitations: Secondary rights/political synthesis rather than court judgment text; causal consequences remain bounded.

title: Human Rights Watch World Report 2006 — Sri Lanka
scope: Aid-distribution disputes and stalled P-TOMS implementation
limitations: Human-rights synthesis; not sufficient alone for election or war-return attribution.

title: Monthly Tourist Arrivals Reports 2019
scope: Monthly and annual tourist arrivals before and after Easter 2019 attacks
limitations: Arrivals are not tourism receipts, employment, GDP share or foreign-exchange earnings.

title: Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority Annual Report 2020
scope: 2020 tourist-arrival collapse relative to 2018/2019
limitations: Arrivals series only; does not directly quantify forex loss.

title: Monthly Tourist Arrivals Reports 2021
scope: Monthly and annual tourist arrivals during 2021
limitations: Arrivals series only; recovery timing differs from receipts and occupancy.

title: Sri Lanka: 2021 Article IV Consultation
scope: Fiscal weakening, import restrictions, fertilizer ban and macroeconomic vulnerabilities before default
limitations: Staff assessment prepared before the April 2022 debt-service suspension; later crisis outcomes require later anchors.

title: Sri Lanka: Selected Issues — tax revenue after 2019 reforms
scope: VAT/NBT changes and collapse in goods-and-services tax revenue
limitations: Fiscal-channel analysis; not a complete causal decomposition of the sovereign crisis.

title: Central Bank of Sri Lanka Annual Report 2022 — External sector
scope: Remittance channel shifts and April 2022 suspension of selected external debt-service payments
limitations: Official retrospective; causal interpretation should be triangulated with external assessments.

title: Sri Lanka Development Update — Mobilizing Tax Revenue for a Brighter Future
scope: 2019 tax cuts, structural revenue weakness and commercial foreign-currency debt vulnerability
limitations: Retrospective policy synthesis; supports multi-causal framing rather than precise causal weights.

title: World Bank Commodity Markets Outlook — tea supply discussion
scope: Sri Lankan tea output decline and fertilizer/input constraints in 2022
limitations: Commodity-market analysis; agricultural decline also reflected affordability and broader crisis conditions.
